description: An orange tracked over-snow vehicle with an enclosed boxy cab sits on two caterpillar tracks in a snowy, ice-ridged landscape. Rope coils hang from it, a roof rack carries a barrel and green canvas bundles, and oil drums are strapped on at the rear. Small flags on poles stand in the snow at left under a dark, stormy sky. No letters, numbers, frame or gore; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
reason: Shows an orange tracked snow tractor crossing ice, but the card is the nuclear icebreaker Lenin, a ship. The picture needs a large icebreaking ship cutting through Arctic sea ice.
